## Setup Environment

```{r}
#| message: false
library(sysgenAnalysis)
```

## Configuration

```{r config}
# NOTE: If rendering from the package library, use 'quarto render ... --execute-dir .'
# to ensure relative paths below resolve to your project directory.
save_dir <- "byandell/output"
base_output <- file.path(save_dir, "eQTL_Analysis")
output_path <- file.path(base_output, "Hotspots")
```

## Load Results from CSVs

```{r load-results}
hs_res <- sysgenAnalysis::read_hotspot_analysis(output_path)
```

## Results

### Summary

```{r}
print(hs_res)
```

### Hotspot Visualization

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 7
plots <- plot(hs_res)

# Display all plots
for (name in names(plots)) {
    print(plots[[name]])
}
```
